title: Disabling and re-enabling of UE's NB-IoT capability

entities.name: Disabling NB-IoT capability
entities.description: Procedure for disabling UE's NB-IoT capability when in NB-S1 mode, involving selection of alternative RATs and PLMNs.

entities.name: Re-enabling NB-IoT capability
entities.description: Procedure for re-enabling UE's NB-IoT capability, triggered by PLMN selection, power cycle, or USIM removal.

entities.name: EMM-IDLE mode
entities.description: EPS Mobility Management idle state where NB-IoT capability can be disabled.

entities.name: EMM-CONNECTED mode
entities.description: EPS Mobility Management connected state where UE must release NAS connection before disabling NB-IoT capability.

entities.name: ATTACH REJECT with NB-IoT not allowed
entities.description: Condition triggered when UE receives ATTACH REJECT or TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT with EMM cause #15 and Extended EMM cause 'NB-IoT not allowed'.

entities.name: Timer for enabling NB-IoT capability
entities.description: Optional timer started by UE to automatically re-enable NB-IoT capability after expiry.

entities.name: Disabling of NB-IoT capability
entities.description: UE action to disable NB-IoT capability and indicate this to access stratum layers.

entities.name: Re-enabling of NB-IoT capability
entities.description: UE action to re-enable NB-IoT capability, either automatically or manually.

entities.name: Extended EMM cause IE
entities.description: Information element carrying extended EMM cause values, including 'NB-IoT not allowed'.

relations.description: Disabling NB-IoT capability can only be performed when UE is in EMM-IDLE mode.
Receiving ATTACH REJECT with NB-IoT not allowed condition establishes the need to disable NB-IoT capability.
The condition is guarded by the Extended EMM cause IE value 'NB-IoT not allowed'.
Re-enabling procedure establishes the property of NB-IoT capability being re-enabled.
Timer expiry establishes the re-enabling of NB-IoT capability.
When in EMM-CONNECTED mode, UE must release NAS connection before proceeding with NB-IoT capability disable procedure.
